provenance_reproduction: All six bundled PNGs reproduced byte-for-byte from SHA256-pinned source maps; all derived manifest hashes verified.
review_profile_decision: Single-sample raster, PBR Neutral, TAA off. 4x MSAA remains explicit opt-in because visual gain did not justify its measured GPU cost for normal review.
comparison_limits: No blind votes or reference-match acceptance. Before/after changes several settings/material/geometry dimensions.
Independent runs can end with different material residency. Same-binary MSAA controls are diagnostics, not strict whole-frame blind evidence.
Timings are serial offscreen diagnostics after warmup; they are not game FPS, a universal budget or a speedup claim.
Earlier preview and contended runs are excluded from final timing claims.
Historical roughness-only RT speedup attribution is not re-certified: the standing 25-window scene actually withholds the entire plant RT partition.
deliberately_not_checked: fresh moving-camera visual sequence or surface-to-orbit acceptance
